notes.title: Major Language Update: Japanese, Korean, Chinese, & Turkish Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update: 5 New Languages Added[/h1]  
Hello everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce our latest [b]Major Update[/b] for [i]Forgotten Memories[/i]! In response to your amazing feedback, we have now introduced full User Interface and Subtitle support for the following languages:

[list]  
[*] Japanese  
[*] Korean  
[*] Simplified Chinese  
[*] Traditional Chinese  
[*] Turkish  
[/list]

We already support [b]English[/b], [b]Russian[/b], and [b]Ukrainian[/b]. With these new additions, even more players around the globe can fully immerse themselves in our world.

We hope you enjoy this update, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the new language options. As always, thank you for your support and for being a part of the [i]Forgotten Memories[/i] community!

[hr]

[b]Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming![/b]
